title: Stewardship & Safety-net: Migration Playbook for Tokens, Buttons, and Charts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: As the design system matured we accumulated several legacy color tokens, button variants, and chart utilities that increase maintenance cost and create inconsistent visual outcomes across products. Current ad-hoc removal attempts (see DES-14220 and DES-20789) repeatedly caused regressions in three customer-facing products. We need a prescriptive, minimally disruptive stewardship process that pairs design, platform, and engineering to manage contributions, RFCs, and deprecations with clear rollback and migration tooling.

Proposal overview: Create a single playbook that governs: contribution acceptance criteria, RFC templates for API/visual changes, a review checklist (design + accessibility + performance), staged deprecation signals, automated migration scripts (codemods + storybook tests), and an incident-safe rollback path. The playbook will be the canonical source for maintainers and will be surfaced in the Design Registry and Design System Confluence space.

Scope: tokens (color, spacing, typography), core components (primary/secondary buttons, icon buttons), tables and charts utilities (axes, themes, responsive behaviors), and documentation/tooling required to support migrations (storybook suites, visual diff baselines, codemods).

Goals: Reduce accidental regressions during removals, shorten time-to-merge for contributor PRs by 30%, provide deterministic migration steps for engineers, and ensure accessible and consistent outcomes for customers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A published playbook page in Confluence that describes the governance flow and is linked from the Design Registry; 2) A one-click checklist template for contributors added to the repo PR template; 3) Two codemods (color-token rename, button variant normalization) landed in the design-system repo with tests; 4) Storybook visual-diff suite updated to cover affected components; 5) A runbook for rollback and customer communication drafted and approved by PM. All items must have signoffs from Design, ENG, and PM.
